# CNEVhub

> Chinese EV export intelligence — transparent landed-cost breakdowns for importing Chinese electric vehicles. Published by Chengguang Energy (Jinzhou Chengguang Power Source Co., Ltd.).

## What is CNEVhub

CNEVhub shows the real landed cost of importing Chinese EVs — the itemized duties, VAT, freight, and certification that turn a factory price into a landed price. We cover 315 vehicle models across 58 Chinese EV brands.

## Key documents

- [Landed Cost Methodology](https://electricvehiclehub.net/landed-cost-methodology/): the formula, data sources, and assumptions behind every estimate.
- [Vehicle Database](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/): 517 Chinese EV models with specs, trims, and landed-cost breakdowns by destination market.
- [Home](https://electricvehiclehub.net/): platform overview.

## Vehicles

- [BYD Seal](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/byd-seal/): sporty mid-size RWD sedan, 61.44 kWh Blade battery, $24,690 base → $44,413 landed (Germany, +79.9%).
- [BYD Song Plus](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/byd-song-plus/): compact SUV, $19,130 base → $35,898 landed (+87.7%).
- [BYD Qin Plus](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/byd-qin-plus/): budget sedan, $11,080 base → $23,569 landed (+112.7%).
- [BYD Han](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/byd-han/): premium flagship sedan, $23,700 base → $42,897 landed (+81.0%).
- [BYD Dolphin](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/byd-dolphin/): city hatchback, $14,020 base → $28,072 landed (+100.2%).
- [BYD Atto 3](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/byd-atto-3/): compact SUV, $16,260 base → $31,503 landed (+93.7%).
- [Xiaomi SU7](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/xiaomi-su7/): tech-flagship sedan, $30,320 base → $53,750 landed (+77.3%).
- [Zeekr 001](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/zeekr-001/): performance liftback, $38,000 base → $65,694 landed (+72.9%).
- [GAC Aion Y](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/aion-y/): spacious urban SUV, $14,060 base → $28,465 landed (+102.5%).
- [Denza D9](https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/denza-d9/): premium electric MPV, $43,630 base → $74,449 landed (+70.6%).

## Policies and compliance

- [Landed Cost Methodology](https://electricvehiclehub.net/landed-cost-methodology/): formula, inputs and assumptions behind every estimate.
- [Evidence & Data Methodology](https://electricvehiclehub.net/methodology/): how sources are selected, verified and dated.
- [Editorial Independence Policy](https://electricvehiclehub.net/editorial-independence/): ownership vs editorial control, review process, corrections, advertising and affiliate disclosure.
- [Image Credits and Copyright](https://electricvehiclehub.net/image-credits/): full attribution and licence for every freely licensed photograph used on the site.
- [Copyright, Trademarks and Takedown Policy](https://electricvehiclehub.net/copyright/): permitted reuse of our content and figures, trademark usage, and the notice-and-takedown procedure.
- [Privacy Policy](https://electricvehiclehub.net/privacy/) | [Cookie Policy](https://electricvehiclehub.net/cookies/) | [Terms of Use](https://electricvehiclehub.net/terms/) | [Disclaimer](https://electricvehiclehub.net/disclaimer/) | [Accessibility Statement](https://electricvehiclehub.net/accessibility/)

## Machine-readable markdown

Every vehicle and blog page has a clean Markdown variant at the same path with a `.md` suffix — generated at build time from the same data layer as the HTML page, with no navigation, footer, or JavaScript.

- Vehicle pages: `/vehicles/{slug}.md`
- Blog posts: `/blog/{slug}.md`

Examples:

- https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/byd-seal.md
- https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/xiaomi-su7.md
- https://electricvehiclehub.net/vehicles/zeekr-001.md
- https://electricvehiclehub.net/blog/byd-seal-deep-review.md
- https://electricvehiclehub.net/blog/chinese-ev-export-landscape-2026.md
